text:
Alex (CEO): Quick live follow-up thread from today's all-hands  feel free to post short questions about mission/positioning/roadmap and we'll reply here.
Maya (Head of Product): We'll triage product questions first, then go to roadmap and market. Keep replies short.
Priya (Solutions): For customer conversations: what is the core buyer pain we should lead with now?
Jordan (Growth): Also need a short rationale for why customers should pick Redwood over a big cloud endpoint.
Alex (CEO): Primary pain = unpredictable inference economics + fragile ops. Lead with: "Predictable, production-grade inference that reduces unit cost and operational burden."
Sam (VP Eng): Can we give an example script for sales? Something under 30s they can use on calls.
Jordan (Growth): Suggested script: "If you care about latency, cost, and not building inference plumbing, Redwood gives a consistent runtime and ops so your team can focus on product." Thoughts?
Maya (Head of Product): Good. Add: "and we support hosted, dedicated, and private deployments for security/compliance needs."
Priya (Solutions): On the onboarding path: customers ask if they can prototype on Hosted then switch to Dedicated without rework.
Ravi (CTO): Yes  same API and model pinning. We provide tools to export configs and pin model versions so switching is low friction.
Jordan (Growth): Competitor messaging: how candid should we be about performance tradeoffs vs the hyperscalers?
Alex (CEO): Be candid but constructive. Hyperscalers win on scale but we win on inference economics and developer experience for LLMs.
Sam (VP Eng): Roadmap: any new launches to call out in PR/marketing over next 6 weeks?
Maya (Head of Product): Shipping: SLA FAQ, Console cost-breakdown widgets, and the first pass of model-variant routing for fallbacks. Public release planned in ~4 weeks.
Priya (Solutions): Customers worried about model drift/regression after model upgrades. What does Redwood offer?
Maya (Head of Product): We have eval hooks + rollout canaries. Customers can run evals on saved prompts and compare outputs before rollout.
Jordan (Growth): Pricing nuance: any change for high-frequency embeddings for vector DB use cases? We need to be ready for 10x usage customers.
Alex (CEO): We're exploring a separate compute/storage split for embeddings and tiered discounts. No commitments yet.
Ravi (CTO): Tech note: we're improving KV-cache policies and prefix caching to lower token counts for batch-heavy workloads.
Sam (VP Eng): For the engineering roadmap, can we prioritize better observability for token-level cost attribution?
Maya (Head of Product): Agreed, making that a high priority. Expect an early UI in the Console within 6 weeks.
allhands-bot: Reminder: quarterly goals doc link posted in #announcements.
Alex (CEO): Thanks all. If anything missed, @me and we'll route to the right PM/Eng owner.
